title: Book 1 — Clio, Chapter 161
paragraphs: After he was dead, Harpagos came down to take his place in command, being also a Mede by race — this was the man whom the king of the Medes, Astyages, had feasted with the unlawful banquet, and who had helped to give the kingdom to Cyrus. This man, appointed commander by Cyrus, came to Ionia and proceeded to take the cities by throwing up mounds against them: for whenever he had enclosed any people within their walls, he then threw up mounds against the walls and took their city by storm. The first city of Ionia upon which he made an attempt was Phocaia.
